items.passageEn: Lena is writing her thesis on the work of a famous theorist who studied how cities grow. Her professor told her to articulate her main idea precisely in one sentence before writing anything else. Lena found this difficult, because the theorist's books are full of complex equations and rich imagery. She decided to start with a clear classification of cities into three types. She also drew a chart with time on one axis and population on the other. Her professor, whom students call "the sage" because of his calm advice, says she has an excellent work ethic.
items.passageZh: Lena 正在寫論文，主題是一位研究城市如何成長的知名理論家。她的教授要她在動筆之前，先用一句話精確地說出她的主要想法。Lena 覺得這很難，因為那位理論家的書裡充滿複雜的方程式和豐富的意象。她決定先把城市清楚地分成三類。她也畫了一張圖表，一個軸是時間，另一個軸是人口。她的教授因為給的建議總是很沉穩，學生都叫他「智者」，他說 Lena 的工作態度非常好。

questions.questionZh: 教授要 Lena 先做什麼？
options: 用一句話精確說出主要想法
先讀完理論家所有的書
訪問城市居民並記下想法

questions.questionZh: Lena 圖表的兩個軸代表什麼？

referenceEn: She spent two years writing her thesis.
It took her two years to write her thesis.
rubricZh: thesis 指（學位）論文（例如 her thesis）
「花了…時間」可寫 spent…writing、It took her… 等

items.instructionZh: 用 articulate 造一個句子，說說你在表達想法時的困難或方法。
referenceEn: Before a big meeting, I write notes so I can articulate my main points.
I am learning to articulate my ideas more clearly at work.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 articulate，當動詞表示「清楚表達」（例如 articulate my ideas）
